title: Line and Special Commands
body: Use enabled Special Commands in main chat. The trigger is removed. Only the configured opt-in role can be notified. Your available commands depend on current server settings and your current roles; there is no command cooldown. Notification mapping: !line → Line Ping; !race → Race Ping; !VC → VC Ping; !Chess → Chess Ping. Event updates do not repeat the start notification.
line: Use !line. The host is automatically in. Members choose I’m In or I Need a Second during 30 seconds of readiness. The host can add 30 seconds once, or start early. When readiness ends, entries lock and the five-second countdown begins automatically. The host may start early or cancel before the countdown. The host may start despite waiting members. Countdown: 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, four-second powder finale, complete. No zero, rematch or Play Again.
vc: !VC sends one voice-chat invitation to VC Ping. VC and Chess triggers are case-insensitive; !vc also works. This does not move members into voice.
chess: !Chess sends one invitation to Chess Ping. !chess also works; this does not start a native chess game.
custom: Authorized enabled custom Special Commands appear in the command list. They send notifications/messages only and cannot replace native Line or Race workflows.

fields.check_in: I’m In means ready; I Need a Second means waiting. These remain visible after entry closes.
fields.host: Only the host can extend once, start or cancel.

steps: Open the authorized Special Command list.
The host may extend, start early or cancel; otherwise the countdown begins when readiness ends.
Watch the shared countdown and completed card.
